newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen rise reflects fundamentals - Sakakibara quoted.
newsitem.headline: Yen rise reflects fundamentals - Sakakibara quoted.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the international finance bureau at Japan's Finance Ministry, said on Wednesday that the recent rise in the yen against the dollar reflects stocks and interest rate fundamentals, Jiji news agency reported.
"Long-term interest rates and stock prices rose before the yen started strengthening. Currencies reacted, reflecting fundamentals in stocks and interest rates," Sakakibara was quoted as saying.
He was asked at a parliamentary committee meeting the reasons for the yen's strengthening since mid-May, Jiji said.
